text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and roadmap in the opening","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents a clear stance and previews the points it will develop, showing more purposeful structure."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with \"First of all,\" \"Secondly,\" and a counterargument","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay uses transitions and paragraphing to connect ideas and move the argument forward more smoothly."},{"evidence":"examples like \"watch someone cook\" and \"Martin Luther King Jr's 'I Have A Dream' speech\"","quality":"supporting detail","description":"The essay develops its ideas with relevant examples rather than leaving claims mostly unsupported."},{"evidence":"\"It could be argued that...\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges an opposing view and responds to it, which shows more mature argumentation."},{"evidence":"mostly controlled sentence patterns and academic phrasing","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows stronger control of sentence structure and formal style, with fewer basic breakdowns than the other essay."}]}
